mapper.select: select (select count(1) from biz_trip_apply) as applyCount, (select count(1) from biz_reimburse) as reimburseCount, (select count(1) from biz_reimburse where status = '1') as pendingCount, (select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) from biz_reimburse where status in ('2','3')) as approvedAmount, (select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) from biz_reimburse where status = '3') as paidAmount
select ifnull(dept_name, '未分配部门') as deptName, count(1) as reimburseCount, ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as totalAmount from biz_reimburse group by dept_name order by totalAmount desc

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') as statMonth, count(1) as reimburseCount, ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as totalAmount from biz_reimburse where create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 11 month) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') order by statMonth
